objective.summary: 재현된 acceptance/numerical/filter/threshold/error-classification 결함을 고치고 SIFT fallback과 direct-source native setup을 문서화한다.
constraints: Public API signatures, package version defaults, vendored native bytes, legacy compatibility types, and host-owned UI/calibration/recipe boundaries remain unchanged.
Do not replace bundled third-party binaries or publish packages, create a release, deploy, or change a consumer repository.
Build, smoke, coverage, and generated verification artifacts stay under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab-Vision-SDK.

criteria.text: Acceptance metrics and active limits fail closed on non-finite values, and direct regression evidence passes.
Modern Core line fitting/angle and 3D plane/volume calculations preserve finite, translation-stable results and reject degenerate or overflowing calculations.
Bilateral filtering and threshold validation execute or reject through explicit typed contracts; OpenCV exceptions are classified by type without substring false positives.
SIFT fallback diagnostics and direct-source managed/native setup are documented, and the current status records scope and boundaries.
Release build, smoke, coverage, exact public API, analyzer, package provenance, isolated package consumer, and remote main delivery pass for one exact commit.

milestones.summary: Fix F1-F3 and F9 numerical/acceptance contracts with direct regressions.
Fix F4-F6 execution and error classification with direct regressions.
Document F7/F8 behavior and align current status with the remediation scope.
Run the clean-commit quality/package gates and record delivery evidence.
